node_types.image_contract: Approved series artwork through the existing avatar/movie-poster pipeline: same configured GCS bucket, ObjectKey, uploader, media ledger/retries, shared logging and renderer. Add shared series-3x2-v1 normalization: store 400x267 WebP (3:2 height rounded to whole pixels) with white canvas, 32px padding and centered proportional containment. Scope the key namespace to canonical series identity and transform version, preserving the source-URL hash. image_url requires a matching successful upload/output receipt. SVG originals require verified source-provided raster renditions. Source, rights, transform and storage receipts remain in shared media/evidence records. Maximum three candidates and one output within original root budgets; missing artwork does not block series identity or trigger discovery.

common_rules: No provider availability or production activation is implied by this design manifest.
Aliases are typed and source-scoped; names alone cannot merge identities.
Only the coordinator admits jobs; support entities are identity-only descendants.
Publication requires game-owned parameters, required stage receipts and approved game artwork in game-thumbnail/.
SQL retains correlated qualifiers and history; graph properties are primitive values and ledger references.
Retries and handoffs preserve the same root budgets.
Game_Release and Game_Award public readiness inherits the associated game publication revision, including their non-game incident edges.

Elected series developer evidence requires Company seeding/reuse and series DEVELOPED_BY replay; member-supported public projections inherit member publication readiness and cannot reveal hidden support.
deferred_semantics: cosmetic DLC and soundtrack game identities

music_entry.deduplication: one probe per canonical music anchor and original root; shared game admission across all source origins

series_developer_queue.series_evidence: one admitted exact series record plus retained member facts; description fallback may reuse official text or fetch at most one additional verified official series/about page within original budgets; emit claims only, no catalog/member-game enumeration
series_developer_queue.manifest: predeclare stage capability; coordinator freezes and reserves combined Company endpoints before identity creation; deterministic originating-game attribution
series_developer_queue.company_resolution: reuse canonical Company UUID or create minimal Entity:Company; deduplicate jobs across game/series references
series_developer_queue.limits: all original root/per-game identity, job, network, byte, retry and lifetime limits remain enforced
series_developer_queue.description: validated non-empty text required before graph replay; suitable source/existing text or bounded GLM 5.3 FLASH at low effort

edge_description_contract.required_for: every game edge; mandatory global edge rule also recorded in mark-graph-skills
edge_description_contract.reuse: existing/source text only if non-empty and still grounded in elected endpoints, facts and scope
edge_description_contract.input: retained eligible evidence only; no browsing, new endpoints or inference that establishes a relation
edge_description_contract.provenance: actual model, effort, prompt version, input hash, evidence revision and successful output receipt in shared description ledger; no invented receipts
edge_description_contract.failure: pending with actual reason; no first edge materialization with blank text, silent model substitution or false success
edge_description_contract.budgets: existing root job, LLM, network, byte, retry and lifetime limits; no new budget
edge_description_contract.corrections: reuse only still-supported text; gate invalidated descriptions until repair; retraction never waits for model generation
edge_description_contract.runtime_gap: inspected shared edgeDescriptionConfig uses the same model at max effort; low effort and pre-write description gating need implementation and QA

build_handoff.phase_advance: all required cases passing with actual current receipts; no skipped/missing required cases

fixture_use_contract.rule: fill required record references from retained exact evidence; add clearly synthetic controls where source data is absent; enforce endpoint-conditional properties; never import all context into one root or fabricate provider evidence
